text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#83421 service=inference-queue severity=critical reason=queue_backlog_high :rotating_light:

sara_oncall: Acked in PD. I'm on it, waking up infra. First check: autoscaler metrics and queue depth.

nick_sre: seeing a big jump in pending_requests on the rps-hotpath autoscaler group. avg queue depth ~8200, target 100. :eyes: CPU on nodes at 92%.

alex_eng: is this the new batching rollout? Any config changes pushed in last 30m?

olivia_platform: No config deploys in last hour. Autoscaler controller logs show repeated scaling decisions but new nodes not joining fast enough. Looks like cloud provider quota limit is hitting.

sara_oncall: can we manual-scale as a mitigation? increase pool minReplicas and temporarily disable scale-down?

nick_sre: manual scale accepted. Running:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-workers --replicas=60 -n prod
kubectl patch hpa autoscaler-hotpath -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 40}}' --type=merge
```

ops-bot: Command executed: scaled deployment inference-workers to 60 replicas.

alex_eng: pushing a quick KC (kube change) to bump max nodes in the pool, provider_quota=100 -> 140. If quota API blocks, open a ticket with cloud.

olivia_platform: Tried to request quota bump, cloud API rate-limited us. I've filed ticket CLOUD-4982 and marked as urgent. Meanwhile I can move some low-priority non-prod pools to different AZs to free up capacity for prod.

sara_oncall: Good. Nick, what's the latency / error profile? Are customers seeing 5xx or just higher latency?

nick_sre: Initial spike caused tokenization workers to time out -> ~1.6% 500s on text-gen endpoints in the last 7m, p95 latency up from 120ms -> 2.3s. Embeddings endpoints unaffected.

alex_eng: We can enable fallback to smaller model variant for best-effort traffic to reduce queue pressure. Will flip a route to model-variant 'opt-legacy' for non-SLA tenants.

sara_oncall: Do it. Add a temporary routing rule with 30% of requests diverted. Keep me posted.

olivia_platform: Rule applied via console: route /v1/generate -> opt-legacy for percentage=30, scope=non-sla. ops-bot: rollback plan?

ops-bot: Rollback command saved: revert route id 8b4f to previous config.

nick_sre: After manual scale and route diversion queue depth down to ~1200 and dropping. CPU on new nodes ~35%. 500s rate down to 0.4%. Still monitoring.

sara_oncall: Thanks. I'll update PD and customer-impact channel. Tagging @olivia_platform for follow-up on quota request. If quota remains blocked we need a longer-term plan (pre-warming, reserved capacity).

olivia_platform: Noted. I'll open a dedicated RFC for reserved capacity for hotpaths, include prewarming playbook and runbook changes.

alex_eng: Log snippet from autoscaler controller for visibility:
```
2024-04-21T02:07:03Z controller: scale_decision desired=58 current=22 reason="queue_depth>threshold"
2024-04-21T02:07:04Z provider_api: create_node_request id=xyz retry=0 status=resource_quota_exceeded
2024-04-21T02:07:08Z controller: requeue decision, waiting for nodes to join
```

sara_oncall: Perfect. I'm handing off to night on-call in 40m. Current status: mitigated but not fully resolved. Action items: (1) olivia follow up CLOUD-4982 quota bump, (2) alex finalize fallback routing and revert plan, (3) nick update playbook with observed timings for manual scale.

nick_sre: I'll write an incident note and add the graphs to the postmortem.

incident-bot: PD#83421 acknowledged by sara_oncall at 1716284825. Status=investigating, priority=P1.

sara_oncall: Leaving a short handoff for night team: queue depth trending down, manual scale in place (60 replicas). If queue depth stops decreasing for 5m, escalate to platform lead and trigger reserved capacity runbook.

olivia_platform: Also adding a temporary autoscaler policy: faster scale-up (cooldown 30s) and disable scale-to-zero for this pool. Will revert after incident.

sara_oncall: Thanks all. Adding final note to PD and posting to #incident-updates. :white_check_mark:
